comparison.objective: Refit and secure a bicycle quick-release wheel; candidate tunes and locks a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Seat both axle ends in fork dropouts and close an over-centre lever in the safe orientation, versus hex-socket manipulation, fine collar rotation, and response-guided retuning.
comparison.success_condition: Wheel must be fully seated before the lever is closed parallel/rearward along the fork; candidate requires a captive setscrew relocked and two compliant dynamic stops without overload or drift.
comparison.reason: Both secure an adjustable mechanism, but they test materially different abilities: wheel/dropout assembly and over-centre closure versus instrumented damping adjustment.
